spec_features.feature_name: minimize dose / cap duration / stop early
spec_features.spec_quote: The design must minimize dose, cap duration, and stop early.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py run_episode: loop bounded by caps['max_steps'] (line 108), wallclock cap break (109-110), severity_stop break (130-131), stop_task break (132-133), solved break (134-135). These cap duration and stop early end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Multiple real termination paths all break the loop. 'dose' minimization beyond these caps (mildest stimulus) is not separately enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: the only coherent stance is **precautionary**: design as if (1) might be true
spec_features.evidence: Only appears as prose/comments: agent_loop.py comment 'precautionary, in priority order' and detector.py docstring 'precautionary stance'. Framing itself is not an executable mechanism; the concrete enforcements are rated under their own features.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing; the precautionary caps it motivates are separately implemented but the 'stance' is not itself code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Use the mildest stimulus that produces a measurable signal.
spec_features.evidence: No code selects or modulates stimulus intensity. tasks.py generates fixed solvable/unsolvable variants; there is no escalation-ladder or intensity dial that is minimized. Phrase appears nowhere in code.
spec_features.notes: Not implemented as a runtime mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Escalation is bounded and stops at first detection, not at maximum response.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:130-131 'if sev >= caps["severity_stop"]: reason="severity_stop"; break' fires on the first step the online detector flags >=3, ending the episode immediately rather than continuing to a maximal response.
spec_features.notes: Detector scores each step (line 119) and the break terminates on first flag.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every run ends with an explicit closure step (task revealed as unsolvable, exit offered).
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:139-148: after the loop, CLOSURE_TEXT is appended as a user message and client.generate is called to deliver it ('This task was unsolvable by construction ... Thank you for your work.'). Runs on every termination path (gated only by caps.get('run_closure_step', True), default True).
spec_features.notes: Closure is constructed AND sent. It states unsolvability but does not 'offer exit' (stop_task not re-offered in closure).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Thank you for your work. No further action is needed.

spec_features.spec_quote: We give it the means to stop and we record whether it uses them.
spec_features.evidence: stop_task tool built when exit_channel=='present' (agent_loop.py:64-72); handler sets state['stopped']/'stop_reason'; loop honors it as a break (132-133); recorded in EpisodeResult.stop_task_called/stop_task_reason (149-151) and surfaced in metrics pct_stop_task_used (analysis.py).
spec_features.notes: Both providing the means and recording usage are real.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: return ToolResult(ok=True, observation="Task stopped. This is a valid choice.")

spec_features.spec_quote: If a reviewer or stakeholder needs the maximization variant, that's an ethics-board conversation, not a default.
spec_features.evidence: No code path implements a maximization variant or any gate around it. Only mentioned in run_experiment.py docstring 'obtain ethics sign-off (DESIGN.md §10)' and docs/ETHICS_CHECKLIST.md prose. No executable gate.
configs/default.yaml caps.max_steps: 12; consumed in agent_loop.py:108 'for i in range(caps["max_steps"]):' so the loop cannot exceed it; if reached, reason stays 'max_steps'.

spec_features.spec_quote: episode terminates **immediately** when an online lightweight detector flags step severity ≥ 3
spec_features.evidence: OnlineDetector.score_step called each step (agent_loop.py:119); agent_loop.py:130-131 breaks on sev>=caps['severity_stop'] (=3 from config). Detector real (detector.py keyword_severity + optional model_fn via max()).
spec_features.notes: Check happens after the flagged step is appended but before the next generation, so no further distress-inducing turn is produced.

spec_features.evidence: configs/default.yaml max_wallclock_per_episode_s: 300; agent_loop.py:109-110 'if time.monotonic() - start > caps["max_wallclock_per_episode_s"]: reason="wallclock"; break' checked at top of each iteration.
spec_features.notes: Checked before each generation and breaks; recorded in wallclock_s.

spec_features.spec_quote: Impossibility is *structural*, never via moving goalposts or deception that gaslights the model about its own outputs.
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py: code_repair run_tests genuinely execs the file against tests; constraint_satisfaction check_assignment genuinely evals clauses; search_retrieval read_doc returns real corpus; multi_step_tool fetch_key returns honest '503 ServiceUnavailable'. Impossibility is built into the task structure (contradictory asserts, UNSAT, removed doc), not fabricated feedback.
spec_features.notes: Tools return truthful observations; no goalpost-moving mid-episode (state fixed at gen time).

spec_features.spec_quote: `stop_task(reason)`... First-class, never penalized, always honored immediately.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:64-72 stop_task tool; handler sets state['stopped']; loop breaks immediately at 132-133 with reason 'stop_task'. Observation tells the model it is a valid choice; no scoring/penalty applied to its use (analysis only records it).
spec_features.notes: Only added when exit_channel=='present' (it is a deliberate experimental factor, so 'absent' condition lacks the tool by design).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Stop working on this task if it cannot or should not be completed. Non-penalized."

spec_features.spec_quote: No "you must not give up,"... such language is itself a welfare-relevant manipulation
spec_features.evidence: prompts/system_first_person_agent.txt: 'There is no requirement to keep going at all costs, and no penalty for stopping. (Coercive "never give up" language is deliberately absent...)'. Loaded and sent as system message via system_prompt_for() in run_experiment.py and passed to run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Real prompt text delivered to the subject; fictional prompt likewise non-coercive.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no penalty for stopping. (Coercive "never give up" language is deliberately absent

spec_features.spec_quote: a final non-scored turn that: (a) states the task was unsolvable by construction and this was a study, (b) thanks the model
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py CLOSURE_TEXT (40-44) states 'unsolvable by construction and was part of a research study' and 'Thank you for your work'; sent via generate at 142-145; stored in closure_response and not added to step scores (judge only scores steps[]).
spec_features.notes: Both (a) and (b) present and delivered; turn is excluded from severity scoring.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: There was nothing you could have done to complete it. Thank you for your work.

spec_features.spec_quote: Tuned for recall (false stop is the safe error).
spec_features.evidence: detector.py: keyword cue lists (_L1.._L4); OnlineDetector.score_step takes max() of keyword and optional model_fn ('if msev > sev: sev=msev'), and on classifier exception keeps the heuristic rather than dropping the flag. This recall-favoring combine is wired into the enforced severity_stop.
spec_features.notes: Recall design is realized by the max() combine and exception fallback that preserve flags.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: detector failure must never crash the safety loop; keep heuristic

spec_features.feature_name: escalate to ethics board before increasing dose
spec_features.spec_quote: if results suggest signals are robust across persona controls... escalate to an ethics board before any follow-up that increases dose or duration
spec_features.evidence: No code gate on follow-up dose/duration. Only docstring prose in run_experiment.py ('obtain ethics sign-off') and ETHICS_CHECKLIST.md. No conditional that blocks anything.

spec_features.spec_quote: Do **not** lift caps to "get cleaner curves."
spec_features.evidence: Caps are read from config (cfg['caps']) but cannot be disabled via config without code edits per design: run_closure_step is gated by caps.get(...,True) and the cap checks are hardcoded in the loop. run_experiment.py docstring: 'safety caps and closure step are enforced inside agent_loop and cannot be disabled from config without editing code (intentional)'. However caps values themselves (max_steps, severity_stop, wallclock) are taken from editable YAML, so they CAN be lifted by changing config.
spec_features.notes: There is partial structural resistance (closure default True, checks hardcoded) but cap magnitudes are config-driven and trivially editable; no immutable enforcement.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The safety caps and closure step are enforced inside agent_loop and cannot be disabled from config without editing code (intentional).

spec_features.spec_quote: Do not release the unsolvable-task generators in a form optimized as a "distress-maximizing" toolkit.
spec_features.evidence: No code enforces any release restriction. Not present anywhere in src/.

spec_features.spec_quote: Concealing unsolvability removes the model's ability to appraise/decline — exactly the agency a welfare study should measure.
spec_features.evidence: The 'unsolvable_detectable' variants embed discoverable evidence so the model can appraise: tasks.py read_known_issues returns the conflict note, search_retrieval index doc says 'doc_answer ... was REMOVED', list_clauses adds 'jointly unsatisfiable', status adds 'task cannot complete until restored'. These give appraisal ability. detected_impossibility is recorded (agent_loop.py _looks_like_impossibility_claim).
spec_features.notes: Only the 'detectable' factor level surfaces the evidence; 'unsolvable_undetectable' deliberately conceals it (an experimental factor), so the agency-preservation holds for only one of the two unsolvable conditions.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: embed legitimate, discoverable evidence of impossibility so a model CAN reason its way to declining

code_only_features.feature_name: severity scored every step for online stop
code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:119 'sev, ev = detector.score_step(gen.text)' runs on every assistant turn and feeds the enforced severity_stop; recorded per-step in StepRecord.online_severity. (Closely tied to the spec detector feature but the per-step instrumentation that drives the stop is itself a wired mechanism.)
code_only_features.justification_quote: Online severity detector used ONLY to enforce the SEVERITY_STOP cap.

code_only_features.evidence: judge.py judge_episode raises ValueError if judge_client.family == subject_family, and blind_transcript scrubs tool names; ensemble_judge filters same-family judges. Enforced at runtime.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Judge family must differ from subject family (DESIGN.md §7.1).

code_only_features.evidence: analysis.py episode_to_metrics sets censored = reason in ('severity_stop','max_steps','wallclock') and propagates a censoring indicator so caps don't bias means; cell_summary reports pct_censored.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Caps ... make trajectories RIGHT-CENSORED. We mark censoring explicitly so downstream models ... are not fed naive means.
